title: SOCIAL-003/004 Trusted Admission Input Contract
purpose: Freeze the minimum trusted server-side admission inputs for Social reaction and comment mutations without inventing a new authority or authorizing runtime execution.

actor.source: authenticated server principal resolved through the existing identity/session authority

target.source: public request identifier resolved against authoritative target domain

decision.rule: W05 MUST fail closed unless all required policy inputs are present, fresh and sourced from an admitted authority.

mutationRules.like: single authoritative reaction write protected by actor+target+reactionType uniqueness; duplicate is idempotent success
mutationRules.unlike: single atomic reaction delete; missing relation is idempotent success
mutationRules.createComment: single authoritative comment write after visibility/commentability/moderation/anti-abuse checks; client cannot set author or final state
mutationRules.patchCommentsCommentId: single authoritative update protected by If-Match/version comparison; client cannot set author/state/version
mutationRules.deleteCommentsCommentId: single authoritative durable state transition to DELETED; client cannot force physical deletion

transportSecurity: No end-user bearer token is forwarded to W05 as authority credential.
Policy decision fields are never accepted from the public client.
Missing or ambiguous authority input fails closed.
Transport is internal-only and carries provenance metadata.
admissionBlockers: trusted W01 to W05 transport binding
exact authoritative source for actor account state
source SHAs for each authority boundary
implementationRule: This contract does not authorize W05 runtime implementation. Implementation remains blocked until the admission blockers are reconciled to existing authoritative contracts and evidence.
